corrected_row.source_language: The actual cost of any digital storage media or device provided by the agency, the actual cost of any container or envelope used to mail the copies to the requestor, and the actual postage or delivery charge.
corrected_row.notes: CD/DVD/USB and other digital storage media/devices: chargeable at ACTUAL COST under the default schedule (no fixed dollar figure) — (2)(b)(v) sits under the 'may not charge in excess of' chapeau, so actual cost is a ceiling. Electronic delivery instead has numeric defaults: five cents per each four electronic files uploaded ((b)(iii), WA-0023) and ten cents per gigabyte transmitted ((b)(iv), WA-0024). Charges under (b) may be combined ((c)).

corrected_row.notes: Mail delivery: actual cost of container/envelope plus actual postage or delivery charge ((b)(v), WA-9010) — a ceiling under the 'may not charge in excess of' chapeau. Electronic delivery defaults (absent published actual costs): 5 cents per each four files/attachments uploaded ((b)(iii)) and 10 cents per gigabyte transmitted ((b)(iv)); agency must use the most efficient manner available in its normal operations. No pickup charge exists (inspection is free, 120(1)).
